name: Ivana Young Man
overview:
Ivana Young Man is a two-hour reality dating special that originally aired on the Oxygen Network on April 29, 2006, after initially being developed for Fox. The show was hosted by Ivana Trump and centered on helping a successful 40-year-old millionaire, Kathy Dahl, find love with a younger man.

The format featured six men in their 20s and early 30s competing through a series of physical, social, and relationship-focused challenges. Throughout the competition, Ivana offered dating advice, evaluated the contestants, and helped eliminate those she felt were not the right match, famously telling eliminated contestants, "You're not desired." The winner was Jeff Lindell. One of the notable contestants was Evan Scott Golden, who went on to build a career as a television host, entertainment reporter, actor, and event emcee. His appearance on the special helped introduce him to a national television audience.
